name: Deore XT direct-mount front derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed average 139 g for FD-M8025-D, 2×11-speed, down swing, direct-mount assembly, including its mounting bolt. The exact column identifies Direct Mount and the weight heading specifies direct type with bolt. Other mounts and model variants do not inherit this weight. The handbook identifies this version for its specified outboard-chainline crank/frame arrangement.
